# Checkpoint Audit

This audit instantiates Brain-JEPA at its native 160-TR grid and at the adapted
16-TR grid. It verifies:

- checkpoint and target patch kernels are exactly identical;
- no learned patch weight is interpolated;
- the checkpoint has 10 temporal patches and the short model has one;
- `native` retains the fixed one-patch sin/cos code generated by the model;
- only the documented downstream `fc_norm` and intentional position-code key may
  be absent during loading.

Run:

```bash
bash run_checkpoint_audit.sh
```

This is an implementation audit, not evidence that a one-patch representation
preserves native-length temporal dynamics.
